signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Set the strategy and roadmap for vehicle monitoring and compliance, and own the outcomes: revenue, retention, reliability, and adoption.
Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of product managers that delivers predictably.
Partner with sales and customer success to win and retain large enterprise customers.
Work with engineering leaders on architecture and platform tradeoffs, and make the final product decision when priorities conflict.
Lead org-wide change programs across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.
Drive revenue expansion strategy for Motive’s core and growing suite of software SKUs, and own pricing and packaging governance from analysis through launch and measurement.
Define how Motive views and manages the cost of R&D spend across devices, cellular, IoT, and software services, and own the cost data foundation behind product-level margin and…
Partner with product line leaders to identify and deliver revenue generation & cost-reduction initiatives that improve gross margin.
Size new product lines and adjacencies, and work with product leadership to run proofs of concept and decide whether to bring new products to market.
Shape long-term product and company strategy, turning market, customer, and competitive insight into multi-year plans and investment choices.
